root_owned_changes_requested.change:
Insert after the existing `site-test` recipe:

# Site verification gates (S3 site_verify; docs/spec/sprints/SITE_VERIFY_S3.md): frozen install (no browser
# download), then the public_site lane tests with the browser suite enabled: check, build, leak scans, internal link
# check, V6 privacy scan, gitleaks with a positive control, Chromium smoke at five viewports and axe in light and dark.
# Nothing is deployed. Outputs go to artifacts/site-verify/<UTC stamp>/ (gitignored).
site-verify:
    #!/usr/bin/env bash
    set -euo pipefail
    out="$PWD/artifacts/site-verify/$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)"
    mkdir -p "$out"
    (cd site && PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD=1 pnpm install --frozen-lockfile)
    SITE_VERIFY_OUT_DIR="$out" SITE_VERIFY_BROWSER=1 PYTHONPATH=tests python3 -m unittest test_public_site_s3 -v 2>&1 | tee "$out/lane-tests.log"
    test -f "$out/browser-summary.json"
    python3 -c 'import json,sys; m=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))["metrics"]; bad=[k for k,v in m.items() if v.get("pass") is not True]; sys.exit("site-verify: failing " + ",".join(bad) if bad else 0)' "$out/browser-summary.json"
root_owned_changes_requested.why: Contract section 11: one operator entrypoint that runs the section 8 gates in order with SITE_VERIFY_OUT_DIR under the root artifacts directory. Not loaded into a justfile by the lane; its commands are the ones the lane ran.

root_owned_changes_requested.change:
Replace the current refusal-only `site-pages-deploy` recipe (its comment line and two-line body) with:

# OUTWARD-FACING: publishes site/build to Cloudflare Pages. Refuses unless the operator sets
# VIDEO_UTILS_SITE_DEPLOY_OPERATOR_GO=deploy-public-site for this one invocation (site/DEPLOY.md).
# Credentials come only from the operator's environment; none is stored in this repository.
# Every verification gate (site-verify: build, leak, link, privacy, gitleaks, browser and axe) runs first.
site-pages-deploy project branch:
    #!/usr/bin/env bash
    set -euo pipefail
    if [ "${VIDEO_UTILS_SITE_DEPLOY_OPERATOR_GO:-}" != "deploy-public-site" ]; then
        echo "site-pages-deploy: refused. Deploying the public site needs a separate operator go; see site/DEPLOY.md." >&2
        exit 64
    fi
    if ! command -v wrangler >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "site-pages-deploy: wrangler is not on PATH; the operator pins and provides it (site/DEPLOY.md)." >&2
        exit 69
    fi
    just site-verify
    cd site && wrangler pages deploy build --project-name {{quote(project)}} --branch {{quote(branch)}}
root_owned_changes_requested.why: Amends the public_site lane's proposed gated deploy recipe so it also requires the browser and privacy gates (site-verify) to be green. It still refuses without the explicit operator-go variable. Not executed by the lane.

root_owned_changes_requested.why: Runs the static gates in hosted CI; the browser suite stays opt-in. Open points recorded in site_verify-root-requests.json: (1) a hosted runner has no run outputs, so the private-run digest group reports checked: false with 0 identifiers, which is not a pass; (2) GitleaksBuildTests skips unless gitleaks is in the shell; (3) python3 availability in .#web was not checked; (4) the lane did not run this workflow.

findings: (1) Scope holds. `git diff --name-only 549a14d...HEAD` in .local/sprint3/site_verify lists 24 files across c878c1c, 152baa1 and 18ba31f. All are owned paths: site/DEPLOY.md, site/e2e/*, site/package.json, site/playwright.config.ts, site/pnpm-lock.yaml, site/src/app.css, site/src/hooks.client.ts, site/tests/browser-ladder.ts, tests/test_public_site_s3.py, docs/spec/sprints/SITE_VERIFY_S3.md and docs/agent-notes/sprints/20261007-s3/site_verify-*.json. There are no root-owned or foreign edits: nothing in web/, just/, program/ or scripts/.

(2) No forbidden writes found. `find artifacts/runs -newermt <contract commit time>` in the main checkout returns nothing. ~/Library/Caches/ms-playwright still holds only chromium-1243, chromium_headless_shell-1234 and ffmpeg-1011, all dated Oct 2 to Oct 6, so no browser was downloaded. Run outputs are in the worktree under artifacts/s2/site_verify/final, which is gitignored (.gitignore:3 /artifacts/). The worktree is clean. Proposed just/workflow.just and ci.yml text is only in site_verify-root-requests.json and was not applied. No wrangler is in package.json or the lock. No daemon: the static server runs inside the Playwright process and global-teardown closes it.

(4) Rerun reproduces the claim. With the given FFMPEG/FFPROBE and `PYTHONPATH=tests python3 -m unittest test_public_site_s3 -v`: 'Ran 85 tests in 134.859s, OK (skipped=2)'. Skips: BrowserSuiteTests.test_v1_to_v7 (opt-in, SITE_VERIFY_BROWSER unset) and LeakRuleTests.test_private_app_hostname_is_absent_when_known (existing). This matches 85 discovered, 83 passed, 2 skipped. The '1 skip' in the browser-enabled final run is consistent, because BrowserSuiteTests runs there.

(4) The tests exercise the claimed behaviour. The link-check self-test plants 8 broken references and 2 broken fragments and asserts exact equality. The privacy self-test asserts 8/8 positives and 0/8 negatives, plus upper-case hex, base64 SRI, binary-embedded digest and IPv6 cases. The gitleaks test uses a positive control that must exit 1. BrowserSuiteTests asserts that V1 to V7 pass, V1 equals 5R/5R, external requests are [] and download bytes are 0. global-teardown counts a missing per-case file against the denominator, and global-setup clears old per-case files first, so stale results cannot pass.

(6) Arithmetic reproduced: smoke 5 routes x 5 viewports = 25; axe 4R+2 = 22; Playwright tests 25 smoke + 5 skip-link + 22 axe = 52. Recomputing from the 22 a11y/*.json files gives 46 incomplete results on 122 nodes. In links-privacy.json, by_kind sums to 139+12+10+41+1+1 = 204, which equals 200 references checked + 4 fragments. The fresh build has 35 files, matching 25 text + 10 binary, and 5 HTML documents, matching R = 5.

(3) Claim classes are correct. Receipts use M/I/U. Pages equivalence is 'inferred', WCAG conformance 'not_claimed', axe incomplete results are recorded as unknown, and zoom is labelled viewport emulation. real_take_accuracy and low_register_pitch_accuracy are 'unknown' and listening_acceptance is 'not_claimed'. There is no note-correctness verdict and no default/profile/detector adoption.

(5) Not applicable to this web-only lane: no DSP, filter or notch is touched. Every subprocess in the test module has an explicit timeout (scanner 60, gitleaks 120, Playwright 900, full digest 600). The Playwright config uses 1 worker, 0 retries and a 60 s per-test timeout.

Minor: the CSS at site/src/app.css:39-46 applies `.site-chrome__quick { min-width:0; overflow-x:auto; padding:0.375rem }` at every width, while the comment describes a fix for widths below about 440px. The extra padding and the scroll container also apply on desktop. Most axe color-contrast incomplete results are on .site-chrome__quick-link nodes, and part of that may come from the new scroll container. This is unverified, because there is no before/after comparison of incomplete counts.

Minor: site/src/hooks.client.ts suppresses console.error for every client error with status 404, not only the fallback route. A genuine client-side 404, such as a broken internal link reached through client navigation, would also go unlogged. The link check covers built references, which reduces the risk.

Minor: in privacy_scan, binary files (10 font/ico files) are checked only for run digests and take identifiers. They are not checked for tailnet names, private IPs, host names, artifacts/ paths or Linear patterns. That is acceptable for fonts, but the '0 hits in each of 8 families over 25 text and 10 binary files' wording overstates how much of the binaries was covered.

In site/pnpm-lock.yaml, playwright@1.63.0 (lines 815 and 1744) has no optionalDependencies. fsevents 2.3.3 at line 1858 belongs to another package (the vite/rolldown block).
